title: generator mod by pisankus
description: this mod adds ore , wood and mob item generators
body:
Generator mod by pisankus is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2 that adds many resource generator blocks for wood, stone, ores, mob drops, and a small set of farming items. Each generator produces its own item over time and can be upgraded up to level 5. Every level is 2x faster than the previous one.
Generators can be crafted with tools based on their category. Wood generators use axes, mob drop generators use swords, farming generators use hoes, sand and gravel generators use shovels, and mining generators use pickaxes. Higher-tier tools create higher-level generators. Generators of the same type can also be combined in an anvil, adding their levels together up to the level 5 limit.
The mod includes Turkish and English language support, custom textures, crafting recipes, loot tables, and a creative tab that only shows level 1 generators. Generators also work like hoppers: if there is a chest or another container underneath, produced items are sent directly into it. If no container is available, items drop on top of the generator, with a maximum pile limit of 256 items.
